verdict.rationale: Omnara documents programmatic agent launch through a CLI, REST API (with OpenAPI spec) and TypeScript SDK, authenticated with bearer API keys that can be assigned scoped roles. A CI/CD job could plausibly call these to start an agent, but nothing documents a CI/CD integration or a build-fixing workflow. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline triggers), a documented workflow for fixing failing builds or tests, a way to pass build or test failure context, a path for pushing fixes or opening PRs back to the repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
